usageNotes: Use this to inspect all ordered entries (permit/deny rules) within a specific SDN route map, including their match conditions and set actions. Requires SDN.Audit or SDN.Allocate on the route-map resource. Use the 'pending' flag to preview uncommitted changes before running 'apply' on the SDN config.

examples.summary: List all entries for a route map named 'bgp-out-filter', showing pending (unapplied) config

tips: Entries are returned ordered by the 'order' field (0–65535); lower order = evaluated first.
The 'call' field chains evaluation to another route map by ID, enabling modular policy composition.
Use 'exit-action' values like 'on-match-next' or 'on-match-goto' to control evaluation flow after a match.
If both 'pending' and 'running' are omitted, the response reflects the saved (committed) config.
The digest field in each entry can be passed to update/delete calls to prevent concurrent modification races.
